mentions.name: NICKEL
mentions.description: A subscription-based short-form video site called NICKEL, built as an alternative to YouTube for sharing gaming clips. Work in progress on the UI and on streaming video handling and optimization, with a feature-complete deadline of April 15th and public updates via a mailing list.
mentions.problem: The author felt uncomfortable using YouTube to share gaming clips and wanted a sustainable own platform instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a subscription-based short-form video site called NICKEL[1]. I felt gross about using YouTube but wanted to share my gaming clips, so I made my own thing.
